summary: Implemented App.call_from_thread in src/textual/app.py, with thread-entry state (_loop, _thread_id) initialized in __init__ and set/cleared in the run_app coroutine's try/finally inside run(). Added tests/test_call_from_thread.py with 9 tests covering the required cases; all 9 pass when run with PYTHONPATH=src. Nothing committed. Caveat: the venv's textual resolves to the base/ checkout, so without PYTHONPATH=src the new tests hang at exit. Three existing async tests in test_screens/test_dom fail because the venv lacks an async pytest plugin (pre-existing environment issue, not caused by these changes).
